hero.heading: A website brings clients. Automation turns them into deals.
hero.subtitle: I'm Stanislav. I set up business process automation with n8n and AI agents, and build websites — from landing pages to web apps. A lead is processed in 1 minute instead of 20, and your team gets dozens of hours back every month.

about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm Stanislav, a business process automation specialist and fullstack developer. I work with small and medium businesses that want to grow without inflating headcount.
about.believe: I believe the future belongs to automation. So I build systems where routine runs itself: an AI agent on n8n takes a request from a website or messenger, qualifies the lead, enters the data into a CRM and notifies the manager in Telegram. Within a minute. No days off, vacations or human error.
about.benefitsLead: What this means for your business:
about.benefit1: faster replies — more deals: the client gets a response while they are still “hot”, not the next morning;
about.benefit2: hours of routine saved every month: data copying, mailouts and reports run without your involvement;
about.benefit3: not a single lead lost: every lead is recorded, qualified and passed on.
about.sites: I build websites end to end: Figma design, responsive markup, backend, deployment. From a landing page on Tilda or WordPress with basic SEO — to a web app on React/Next.js and Node.js.
about.solo: I work solo, and that's your advantage: you talk directly to the person who designs, builds and ships. Fast decisions, no “broken telephone”, full responsibility for the result.
